other_conditions: Orphaned or destitute children, including those living with next of kin, whose parent(s) have died, are mentally disabled, imprisoned, or otherwise unable to raise them
Children suffering from HIV/AIDS, AIDS, or Visible Deformities Grade‑II (Leprosy) and children of parents suffering from these conditions
Eligibility ends if the compelling situation (e.g., death or disability of parents) is resolved
Benefits are granted for one year and automatically renewed each year until the child turns 18, provided no adverse report is received
benefits_summary: ₹1,000 per month is transferred directly to a joint savings account opened with the child’s parents.
